implementation_constraints: reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0

unresolved_intent.decision: reject null, numbers, and non-string/bool values as malformed input
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec constraint explicitly states 'string or bool'; null and numeric types violate this hard boundary

unresolved_intent.decision: errors list preserves insertion order from initial model's fields array
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec says errors 'in field order'; only defined order is the initial model; Python 3.7+ preserves dict insertion order

unresolved_intent.decision: output compact JSON (no spaces) via json.dumps()
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec: 'Output formatting is free; only structure and values are fixed'

unresolved_intent.decision: silently ignore extra fields in model and event objects
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec defines required fields; extra fields don't violate structure—only missing/wrong-typed fields do
